_: Input for scripts/build-sheet-templates.mjs: which sheet boards become spreadsheet templates, in the order the start screen shows them, and the words the start screen uses. sheets says what each sheet is for (for AI apps). The live parts of each template (formulas, formats, rules, drop-downs, charts) are in scripts/sheet-templates/<board>.json.

boards.name: Household Budget
sheets: Monthly overview: income, bills, spending by category with data bars, a doughnut chart and a savings goal
Transactions: dated money in and out with categories and a running balance
Categories: the list the category drop-downs use

boards.name: Project Plan
boards.blurb: Tasks, owners, status and a timeline
sheets: Tasks: phases and tasks with owner, status, priority, dates and progress
Timeline: a Gantt chart by week, drawn with conditional formatting
Risks
Team

boards.name: Fundraiser
sheets: Donations: dated gifts with donor, event, amount, method and Gift Aid
Summary: raised by event, top fundraisers and coming events

boards.name: Trip Planner
sheets: Itinerary: day by day plan with travel and bookings
Budget and packing: costs per person and a packing list with tick boxes

boards.name: Grade Book
boards.blurb: Marks, averages and grades for a class
sheets: Marks: pupils' marks per assessment with averages and grades
Class summary: grade spread and averages per assessment

boards.name: Habit Tracker
sheets: Month grid: a tick per habit per day, with streaks and scores
Workouts: a log of sessions with distance, time and pace

boards.name: Stock and Sales
boards.blurb: What's in stock, what to reorder, what sold
sheets: Stock: items with quantities, reorder levels and value
Sales: sales by week and item
Till: the till's sales lines the other sheets add up (hidden)

boards.name: Timesheet and Invoices
boards.blurb: Hours by client, and what you've billed
sheets: Weekly timesheet: hours per day per client and project
Invoices: billed, paid and overdue

boards.name: League Table
sheets: Fixtures and results
League table worked out from the results

boards.name: Wedding Guest List
sheets: Guest list with RSVP drop-downs and counts
Seating plan and budget against actual

boards.name: Meal Planner
boards.blurb: A week of meals and the shopping list
sheets: Weekly meal plan with costs and calories
Shopping list by aisle with a budget

boards.name: Savings Tracker
boards.blurb: Goals, deposits and how far to go
sheets: Savings goals with progress and the monthly amount needed
Monthly deposits per goal with a running total
